connector.name: John's Essentials
connector.registryDescription: 110+ deterministic file tools: PDF, image, media, convert, analyze. Connect in one click (OAuth).
connector.summary: Hosted at api.johnsessentials.com over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.johnsessentials, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. OAuth 2.1 is the primary auth and is discovered automatically at the endpoint (RFC 9728 — an unauthenticated request returns a 401 with the authorization-server metadata). Alternatively, send a Bearer API key from https://app.johnsessentials.com/integrations?tab=apikeys (format: 'Bearer je_live_sk_...').
